grain: one frozen entry and source side; loss quantities remain separate observations
side_orientation: A is France and its allies, using frozen french_side; retain printed winner/loser columns only as provenance
rules: Missing or unstated is null, never zero. Explicit printed zero retains its evidence.
Never split a combined killed-and-wounded count into separate categories.
Preserve wounded prisoners, officer subsets, surrender populations and alternative time spans; do not sum overlapping categories.
Retain printed aggregates and exact source arithmetic disagreements. Derived arithmetic is labelled and never repairs the source.
Retain qualifiers, ranges, approximate figures, units, population, event scope and source notes.
Do not turn material counts or percentages into personnel, and do not silently derive missing personnel counts from strength.
Treat source-local counts as reported claims, not historically adjudicated losses.
Keep existing dossier disputes as linked, unreconciled alternatives; reinspection status must be explicit.
Assess named component pair coverage separately by engagement type. No arbitrary coverage threshold substitutes for comparable definitions.
universal_measure_go_rule: A single common loss measure is supportable for the whole fixed group only if its explicitly defined personnel category and population/time interpretation are supported on both sides of every entry without zero imputation, overlapping-category sums, unresolved arithmetic or mixing material and personnel. Report narrower component coverage even when this fails.
interpretation: A supported loss component describes attrition recorded by this source, not strategic value, commander credit or campaign contribution. No utility weights or graded victory score are assigned.
